The book The Sized Chemicals and Psychoactive Plants, published by John Wiley & Sons in Hoboken, NJ, in 2012, provides a comprehensive exploration of psychoactive substances derived from plants and synthetic chemicals. 2. Edited by Dargan PI and Wood DM, Novel Psychoactive Substances: Classification, Pharmacology, and Toxicology, published by Academic Press in London in 2013, delves into the categorization, pharmacological properties, and toxicological profiles of emerging psychoactive substances. 3. Clinical Neurotoxicology: Syndromes, Substances, Environments, authored by Dobbs MR and published by Saunders in Philadelphia, PA, in 2009, examines the clinical manifestations and environmental factors associated with neurotoxic agents. 4. The 7th edition of Fisher’s Contact Dermatitis, edited by Fowler JF and Zirwas MJ, was published by the Contact Dermatitis Institute in Phoenix, AZ, in 2016. This text is a key resource on the diagnosis and management of contact dermatitis. 5. The Drug Abuse Handbook, authored by Karch SB and Goldberger BA, is in its 3rd edition and was published by CRC Press in Boca Raton, FL, in 2013. It provides an in-depth analysis of drug abuse and its implications. 6. The German-language book Arzneimittel in Schwangerschaft und Stillzeit, edited by Schäfer C, Spielmann H, Vetter K, and Weber-Schöndorf C, is in its 8th edition and was published by Elsevier in Munich in 2011. It focuses on the use of medications during pregnancy and lactation. 7. In Portuguese, Toxicologia Forense, authored by Dorta DJ, Yonamine M, Costa JL, and Martinis BS, was published by Blucher in São Paulo in 2018. It addresses forensic toxicology principles and applications. 8. Current Veterinary Therapy: Food Animal Practice, edited by Anderson DE and Rings DM, is in its 5th edition and was published by Saunders in St. Louis, MI, in 2009. It provides veterinary therapeutic approaches for food animals. 9. Kirk’s Current Veterinary Therapy XV, edited by Bonagura JD and Twedt DC, was published by Saunders in St. Louis, MI, in 2014. This text is a critical resource for veterinary medicine. 10. Edited by Gupta RC, Veterinary Toxicology: Basic and Clinical Principles, published in 2018, offers foundational and clinical insights into veterinary toxicology. 11. Plumb’s Veterinary Drug Handbook, authored by Plumb DC, is in its 8th edition and was published in 2015. It serves as a comprehensive guide to veterinary pharmacology. 12. The 10th edition of Veterinary Pharmacology and Therapeutics, edited by Riviere JE and Papich MG, was published in 2018. It provides an extensive overview of veterinary pharmacological practices. 13. Robinson’s Current Therapy in Equine Medicine, authored by Sprayberry KA and Robinson NE, is in its 7th edition and was published by Saunders in St. Louis, MI, in 2014. It focuses on equine medical therapies. 14. In German, Lehrbuch der Pharmakologie und Toxikologie für die Veterinärmedizin, edited by Löscher W and Richter A, is in its 4th edition and was published by Enke in Stuttgart in 2016. It is a textbook on pharmacology and toxicology for veterinary medicine. 15. In Portuguese, Toxicologia Aplicada à Medicina Veterinária, authored by Spinoza HS, Górniak SL, and Palermo-Neto J, was published by Manole in São Paulo in 2008. It discusses applied toxicology in veterinary medicine. 16. Pediatric Environmental Health, edited by Etzel R and Balk SJ, is in its 4th edition and was published by the American Academy of Pediatrics Council on Environmental Health in Ithaca, IL, in 2019. It addresses environmental health issues affecting children. 17. Children’s Health and the Environment – A Global Perspective, edited by Pronczuk-Garbino J, was published by the World Health Organization in Geneva in 2010. It examines the global impact of environmental factors on children’s health. 18. The Air Quality Guidelines for Europe, 2nd edition, was published by the WHO Regional Office for Europe in Copenhagen in 2001. It provides guidelines for maintaining air quality to protect public health. 19. The Guidelines for Drinking-Water Quality, 4th edition incorporating the first addendum, was published by the World Health Organization. It outlines standards for safe drinking water. 20. In Spanish, Toxicología Ambiental: Seguridad Química, authored by de la Peña de Torres E and Gómez Campoy E, was published by the Asociación Española de Toxicología in Murcia in 2004. It focuses on environmental toxicology and chemical safety. 21. The American Journal of Industrial Medicine, published by Wiley in Hoboken, NJ, USA, is a leading journal covering occupational health and industrial medicine. 22. Annals of Work Exposures and Health, published by Oxford University Press in the United Kingdom, focuses on occupational and environmental health research. 23. Archives of Environmental Contamination and Toxicology, published by Springer in New York City, USA, explores the impact of environmental contaminants on health. 24. Clinical Toxicology, published by Taylor and Francis Group in the United Kingdom, provides peer-reviewed research on toxicology and poisoning management. 25. Environmental Health Perspectives, published by the National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences in the USA, is a key resource on environmental health research. 26. Toxicology Letters, published by Elsevier in Amsterdam, Netherlands, offers concise reports on toxicological research. 27. The EFSA Journal, an open-access publication by the European Food Safety Authority, provides scientific evaluations and risk assessments of chemicals in food and feed. 28. The IRIS Database, maintained by the US Environmental Protection Agency, identifies and characterizes health hazards of environmental chemicals. 29. The CompTox Chemicals Dashboard, hosted by the US EPA, provides access to data on the chemistry, toxicity, and exposure of over 875,000 chemicals. 30. Wikitox, an open-access curriculum project, aims to improve the treatment of poisoning cases and is freely available online. These resources collectively provide a wealth of information on toxicology, pharmacology, environmental health, and related fields, catering to medical, veterinary, and environmental professionals.
